title: The reading room from the stacks
logline: The reading room seen from between two archive shelves, the green lamp, the table, the chair with the cardigan, and the glass door beyond with the hall. The page's one view from inside the archive, where his folder lives, looking out at the room where it's read.

panels.composition: Between two metal archive shelves, a view of a reading room: a green lamp on a table, a chair with a gray cardigan over its back, a glass door to a hall beyond.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a view from between two metal archive shelves of a reading room with a green-shaded lamp on a table, a chair with a gray cardigan over its back and a glass door to a hallway beyond, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
